execution: Set hands moderately wider than shoulders, lower within a comfortable range, and press away.
Complete the final repetition with the same controlled range, then exit the position safely.
Move smoothly into the working range while keeping the listed primary muscles in control.
Pause briefly at the change of direction, then return to the start without bouncing or rushing.
Reset in the stable start position before beginning the next repetition.
cues: Keep every repetition deliberate and repeatable.
Let the chest produce the movement while the rest of the body stays organized.
mistakes: Flaring excessively or forcing bottom range.
Continuing after position, control, or equipment security is lost.
Adding load after the intended range or body position begins to change.
Rushing the return and losing control near the end of the repetition.
education.whatMoves: The working joints move through the horizontal push pattern under control.
education.whatStaysStable: Keep the trunk, head, and non-working joints steady unless the movement explicitly requires them to travel.
education.rangeOfMotion: Use the largest pain-free range you can repeat without momentum or a change in the intended position.
education.feel: Expect controlled effort through the chest, not sharp or joint-focused pain.
education.stopModify: Stop or shorten the range for sharp, sudden, worsening, or joint-focused pain; choose a reviewed alternative when needed.
